items.title: Saline golf course sold as $16B data center rises next door
items.dek: Developer buys Rustic Glen Golf Club in Saline while promising to keep it open, even as residents voice ongoing concerns over the adjacent Oracle-backed project and its tax break.
items.judge_note: Concrete new development: a specific property transaction (golf course sale) tied to the Oracle data center project, with developer commitment on record.
